Overview

Hus Website is a corporate web project built to present the brand, services, and business context through a clean responsive experience. The site was developed with Next.js and Tailwind CSS for a production-oriented frontend workflow.

Focus

The focus was owning the design-to-code path: shaping the visual direction, implementing reusable frontend sections, and making sure the site worked across responsive breakpoints with a clear, professional presentation.
